generationLineage.promptText: One original photorealistic editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. Fictional Southern European male software founder in his late thirties, medium olive skin, short dark wavy hair, a little grey at temples, clean quiet navy overshirt, no tie. Candid three-quarter interview pose facing slightly camera-left, looking to interviewer just off camera, measured conversational expression. Natural unretouched face and credible visible hands. Frame with generous headroom and visible shoulders at eye level, 65mm-equivalent lens. Bright loft meeting room with white cotton-paper samples and a pale desk in foreground, navy upholstered wall panel 2 metres behind, one cobalt object far in background, daylight through tall window camera-left. Background depth is photographic and layered, not flat painted backdrop. Soft directional light with fine shadow modeling and gentle separation; balanced white, navy, neutral silver accents. No final frame, typography, logo, UI, watermark, fake company proof. Original fictional person only; elegant editorial photography, no model glamour or metal overload.
